name: Country Hills Shopping Center

description: Country Hills Shopping Center is a Ralphs-anchored community shopping center strategically located at 2905-2965 Rolling Hills Road in Torrance, California. Spanning 53,200 square feet, this well-positioned retail destination serves as a vital community hub for the affluent neighborhoods of Torrance, Rolling Hills Estates, and Rancho Palos Verdes. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility, situated within 1 mile of Highway 1 with 44,000 vehicles passing daily, while also enjoying high traffic counts on Hawthorne Boulevard (33,000+ vehicles daily) and Crenshaw Boulevard (29,000+ vehicles daily). The property features a diverse tenant mix including the grocery anchor Ralphs, complemented by essential services like Rolling Hills Dental Care, All Kidz Urgent Care, and Country Hills Cleaners, as well as popular dining options such as Lamppost Pizza, Utsav Indian Cuisine, and Wa-Dining Suya. Fitness and wellness offerings include YogaSix, while specialty retailers and services like Slay Nails & Spa, Hair Diamond, and Hills Academy round out the tenant roster, creating a comprehensive shopping and service destination for the surrounding community of over 156,000 residents within 3 miles.
